definition: Devotion — the sthāyibhāva (stable emotion) that is the central mood of the stotra. In Kashmir Śaivism, bhakti is not a means among means but the thing itself; it is the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute. Utpaladeva asks for bhakti itself, not for what devotion might get him.

sources.claim: Bhakti is the highest path to advaita; it is not opposed to non-duality but complementary.
Bhakti is the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute; the sthāyibhāva of devotion.
